choose_language:
🚗 JAC PARTS

Выберите язык / Choose language / Tilni tanlang
contact_manager_text: 📞 Write to us and a manager will reply shortly.
error_generic: ⚠️ Something went wrong. Please try again or press /start.
region_unavailable: ⚠️ This region is unavailable. Please choose another one.
catalog_empty: 📭 The catalog is empty for now. Please check back later.
item_unavailable: ⚠️ This section is no longer available. Please open the catalog again.
ask_phone:
📞 One last step — please share your phone number.

Tap the button below 👇 A manager will use it to contact you about orders.
phone_not_own: ⚠️ Please share your own number using the button below.
phone_invalid: ⚠️ Could not read the number. Please tap the button below.
web_search_placeholder: Search by name or part number
web_price_soon: Dealer prices and stock will appear in the next update
web_checkout_soon: Checkout will be available in an upcoming update. Your cart will be kept.
web_orders_empty_hint: Your orders and their statuses will appear here
web_not_registered_text: Go back to the bot chat, press /start, choose your region and share your phone number.
web_open_in_telegram: Please open the catalog from the Telegram bot
web_catalog_empty: The catalog is empty for now
open_app_text: 🛍 JAC parts catalog — tap the button below to open it.
menu_hint: Choose a section in the menu below 👇
cart_empty:
🛒 Your cart is empty

Add parts from the catalog: 🛍 Catalog → part → “🛒 Add to cart”.
orders_empty:
📦 You have no orders yet.

To order: 🛍 Catalog → part → “🛒 Add to cart” → 🛒 Cart → “✅ Checkout”.
ask_phone_change: 📱 Tap the button below to share your new number.
template_caption:
📄 Catalog template.

Fill in the “parts” sheet (tips are on the “инструкция” sheet) and send the file: /admin → 📥 Upload Excel.
import_ask_file:
📥 Send the catalog Excel file (.xlsx).

The file is a full price list: parts missing from it will be hidden in the bot.
import_bad_extension: ❌ An Excel file with the .xlsx extension is required
import_too_big: ❌ The file is larger than {mb} MB
import_fix_hint: Fix the file and upload it again. The database was not changed.
import_cancelled: Import cancelled. The database was not changed.
import_expired: ⚠️ File not found — please upload it again.
import_db_error: ❌ Database write error. All changes were rolled back; the database is unchanged.
err_unreadable: could not read the file — is it really an Excel .xlsx?
err_no_rows: the file has no data rows
err_price: invalid price “{value}” (must be a number above 0)
err_stock: invalid stock “{value}” (must be a whole number 0 or more)
err_delivery: invalid delivery time “{value}” (must be a whole number of days)
err_duplicate: duplicate: this part for this dealer is already in row {other}
err_conflict_node: part number {number} ({model}) has a different category in row {other}
warn_default_region:
⚠️ {n} dealers are not in the directory — placed in “Tashkent” for now: {dealers}.
Add them to the dealer directory and upload it (or set them in app/services/import_mapping.py).
warn_bad_row: row skipped: no name or quantity
no_offers_in_region: 😔 No dealer in your region has this part yet.
offers_elsewhere: It is in stock in other regions ({n}). You can change your region: 👤 Profile → 📍 Change region.
cart_limit: ⚠️ No more stock at this dealer (in cart: {qty} pcs)
cart_item_unavailable: ⚠️ Out of stock now — not included in the total
cart_limit_short: ⚠️ No more stock at this dealer
warn_unknown_models:
⚠️ Unknown model codes (shown as is): {models}.
Names are set in app/services/import_mapping.py (MODEL_NAMES).
warn_untranslated:
🌐 No Russian/Uzbek translation ({n}): {names}.
They will be shown in English. Translate them in the web panel: “Catalog” → “Untranslated”.
checkout_split: ℹ️ Parts are from {n} dealers — {n} separate orders will be created.
checkout_confirm_hint: A manager will contact you at the phone number in your profile.
checkout_stock_changed: ⚠️ Stock changed while you were checking out:
checkout_now_n: now {n} pcs in stock ({want} in cart)
checkout_fix_cart: Please adjust the quantities in your cart and check out again. No order was created.
checkout_nothing: ⚠️ There are no in-stock parts in your cart.
order_cannot_cancel: ⚠️ This order can no longer be cancelled — please contact the manager.
adm_search_bad: ⚠️ Please send an order number — digits only.
dealer_shown: Dealer is shown to customers again.
adm_dealer_note: ℹ️ Uploading the dealer directory will replace this with the Active/Inactive status from the file.
staff_empty: No staff yet. Tap “🔗 Invite staff member”.
staff_removed_notice: You no longer receive orders of “{dealer}”.
invite_ok:
✅ You are connected as a staff member of “{dealer}”.

New orders for this dealer will arrive here. All orders — the “📋 Dealer orders” button in the menu below.
invite_used: ⚠️ This link has already been used. Ask the administrator for a new one.
invite_expired: ⚠️ This link has expired. Ask the administrator for a new one.
admin_staff_joined: 🔔 {name} joined as a staff member of “{dealer}”.
not_staff: ⚠️ You are not connected to a dealer.
chat_ask:
✍️ Write a message about order #{id} — it will be sent to {whom}. You can attach a photo.

To cancel, tap “❌ Cancel”.
chat_no_staff: ℹ️ The dealer has no staff in the bot yet — the message was forwarded to the administrator.
chat_failed: ⚠️ Could not deliver the message: the recipient has blocked the bot.
export_empty: No orders in this period — nothing to export.
backup_caption:
💾 Database backup from {date} ({size}).

Keep it outside the server. How to restore — see README, “Restore from backup”.
backup_none: ⚠️ No backups yet. Check the backup container: docker compose logs backup
backup_too_big: ⚠️ The backup is larger than 50 MB — Telegram won't send it. Download it from the server: ~/parts_bot/backups
web_disabled: Web panel access disabled. All sessions ended.
web_ask_admin: You have no access to the web panel. Ask the administrator for an invitation.
panel_invite_ok: ✅ You have been added to the JAC Motors Parts web panel.
admin_panel_joined: 🔔 {name} was added to the web panel. Role: {role}.
panel_disabled_notice: Your web panel access was disabled by the administrator.
user_blocked: ⛔ Your access to the bot is restricted. If this is a mistake, please contact JAC Motors.
